authority: North Star Product Board interpreted as product architecture, not an asset reference
hierarchy: screen -> region -> block -> slot -> state -> component/asset

S00.name: Splash / Loading
S00.purpose: Enter the world, load durable player state, establish tone and reach the House safely.

S01.name: House Hub
S01.purpose: Show persistent House state, player resources and the next meaningful action.

S02.name: Chapters
S02.purpose: Choose a House wing while preserving visible long-term progression.

S03.name: Chapter Detail / Route
S03.purpose: Choose the next level inside the active House wing and understand opening progress.

S04.name: Level Pre-start
S04.purpose: Explain objective, move budget, consequence and optional truthful aids before play.

S05.name: Match-3 Gameplay
S05.purpose: Solve the active puzzle with clear objectives, readable pieces and recoverable session controls.

S06.name: Win / Rewards
S06.purpose: Make success, earned reward and persistent House consequence unambiguous before continuation.

S07.name: House Restoration
S07.purpose: Show the exact persistent House change caused by a first-time win using the same House camera.

S08.name: Curio Collection
S08.purpose: Inspect owned Curios, understand missing Curios and open detail without inventing progress.

S09.name: Weekly Missions
S09.purpose: Show weekly goals and truthful claim state only when live mission data exists.

S10.name: Event Center
S10.purpose: Discover active or upcoming events and enter only eligible real content.

S11.name: Shop
S11.purpose: Present economy surfaces truthfully; no enabled payment interaction before real commerce is connected.

S12.name: Profile
S12.purpose: Show Keeper identity, opening-chapter progress, Curio/House progress and truthful local-save health, with Settings as a separate suspended-origin surface.

golden_acceptance: House primary CTA opens S03 current chapter route and never bypasses directly to S04.
S03 level selection is the only normal entry to S04; S04 back returns to S03.
S05 supports pause/resume/settings and fail/retry/exit recovery.
S06 precedes durable exactly-once progression commit and S07 ceremony.
S07 changes the same House state/camera and returns to S01.
S08 reflects the exact Curio earned in S06/S07 and persists after relaunch.
No random secondary-screen polish or bulk art is allowed before rendered Golden Loop acceptance.

production_gate.rule: No new production art is authorized until every canonical screen/overlay slot has explicit geometry and the implemented geometry passes real Godot render inspection.

geometry_system.rule: Every live slot owns an explicit 1080x1920 logical geometry contract before any new production asset is generated or polished. Container-flow slots use bounded target boxes; full-bleed art owns the viewport; runtime VFX follows its semantic owner.
